name: Accenture
description: Accenture sells the time of its people. About 779,000 employees are billed to large companies and governments (more than 9,000 clients, three quarters of the Fortune Global 100 and 500) under time-and-materials, fixed-price and fee-per-transaction contracts. Half of revenue is Consulting (projects) and half is Managed Services (multi-year contracts to run part of a client's operations, billed each period). Payroll is the main cost (63 percent of revenue in the Q3 FY2026 segment table, computed), so profit depends on how many people are billed, the rate charged, and the use of subcontractors and lower-cost locations. Most contracts can be cancelled by the client on short notice, so the firm remaining obligations of about $34B are small next to $69.7B of annual revenue.
